7568.cn: 她脸上明显流露出不信任的表情。

7570.en: The play was OK, but it wasn't anything to write home about.
7570.cn: 这个剧还算可以，但也没好到哪儿去。

7571.en: AIL telephone reservations must be confirmed in writing.
7571.cn: 所有的电话预约必须以书面形式确认。

7572.en: The writing is on the wall for the club unless they can find E20 000.
7572.cn: 这家俱乐部就要大难临头了，除非他们能筹到 20000 英镑。

7576.en: Please don't get me wrong, I'm not criticixing you.
7576.cn: 请别误会，我不是在责怪你。

7577.en: You've got the wrong end of the stick. He doesn't owe me money, Iowe him!
7577.cn: 你弄错了。不是他欠我钱，是我欠他钱!

7578.en: It doesn't work. We must have gone wrong somewhere. Pass me the instruction manual.
7578.cn: 这不管用，我们一定是哪儿弄错了。把说明书递给我。

7579.en: She is clearly in the wrong. She had no right to take the book.
7579.cn: 很明显，责任在她，她无权拿走这本书。

7580.en: The TV presenter found himself on the wrong side of the law after hitting a cyclist while driving.
7580.cn: 那位电视节目主持人开车撞了一个骑自行车的人，惹上了官司。

7581.en: Don't take this the wrong way, but don't you think you should get your hair cut?
7581.cn: 你别误会，我无意冒犯，可是你不觉得自己该理发了吗？

7582.en: For a quick meal you can't go wrong with pasta.
7582.cn: 要想吃快餐，点意大利面准没错。

7584.en: Did you mean what you said or were you just yanking my chain?
7584.cn: 你是说真的呢，还是逗我玩？

7588.en: The 200 is all year; all the time open to visitors all year round.
7588.cn: 动物园全年对游客开放。

7590.en: The case contained old papers going back to the year dot.
7590.cn: 这个箱子里装着很久以前的文件。

7591.en: The hotel has won the top prize year after year.
7591.cn: 这家宾馆每年都贏得最高奖项。

7592.en: Year by year their affection for each other grew stronger.
7592.cn: 他们对彼此的爱一年比一年强烈。

7593.en: He had travelled on the 7.40 train to London year in, year out for thirty years.
7593.cn: 他坐 7:40 的火车来伦敦，年年如此，坐了整整三十年。

7594.en: Spending has increased year on year.

7595.en: Ta never have thought of that in a million years.
7595.cn: 我永远也想不出那个主意。

7596.en: The shock of losing his job put years on him.
7596.cn: 失业的打击让他看起来老了不少。

7597.en: The new hairstyle takes years off her.
7597.cn: 新发型让她看起来年轻多了。

7599.en: He won't fight?I always thought he had a yellow streak in him.
7599.cn: 他不想打架？我早知道他没这个胆子。

7605.en: He says that the secret of living to 100 is to remain young at heart.
7605.cn: 他说活到100 岁的秘诀就是要有一颗年轻的心。

7607.en: The band's fans are getting younger.
7607.cn: 这支乐队的歌迷越来越年轻了。

7608.en: I can't possibly walk all the way to the beach -I'm not getting any younger, you know.
7608.cn: 我不能一路走到沙滩去了。你要知道，岁月不饶人啊。

7609.en: You must provide a safe future for you and yours.
7609.cn: 你一定要给自己和家人一个稳定的将来。
